heading: Definitions of national laboratory and nuclear weapons production facility

tree.text: The term “national laboratory” means any of the following:

children.text: The Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, Livermore, California.
The Los Alamos National Laboratory, Los Alamos, New Mexico.
The Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, New Mexico and Livermore, California.

tree.text: The term “nuclear weapons production facility” means any of the following:

children.text: The Kansas City Plant, Kansas City, Missouri.
The Y–12 Plant, Oak Ridge, Tennessee.
The tritium operations at the Savannah River Site, Aiken, South Carolina.

notes.text: References in TextThis subchapter, referred to in text, was in the original “this subtitle”, meaning subtitle D of title XXXI of div. C of Pub. L. 106–65, Oct. 5, 1999, 113 Stat. 931, which is classified principally to this subchapter. For complete classification of subtitle D to the Code, see Short Title note set out under section 7383 of this title and Tables.
